criteria.label: Comprehension
criteria.question: Which treatment makes the meaning easier or faster to grasp?

criteria.label: Cognitive work
criteria.question: Does the visual perform comparison or topology work that text leaves to the learner?

criteria.label: Decoding overhead
criteria.question: Does the visual introduce more grammar than it removes?

criteria.label: Truthfulness
criteria.question: Does either treatment imply meaning absent from trusted evidence?

criteria.label: Text burden
criteria.question: Does useful visualization make the prose cognitively lighter?

criteria.label: Restraint
criteria.question: Where the gate selected prose, does that choice feel appropriate?

criteria.label: Distinctiveness
criteria.question: Where selected, does the visual read as knowledge rather than interface chrome?
